title: Counting Schreier Sets Under Neighborhood Conditions
summary: We count Schreier sets that satisfy a neighborhood condition, including $k$-clustered, $k$-consecutive-free, $k$-neighbored, $k$-isolated, and closed under integral $2$-averages. For the first four conditions, we determine the initial counts and prove linear recurrence relations. For the last condition, we prove a recurrence that involves the divisor counting function.
